tools.name: skedda_list_assets
tools.description: List the venue's assets: bookable spaces, individual space assignments and add-ons. Filter by category. Returns one page with paging.cursor. Skedda API: GET /api/v1/assets.

tools.name: skedda_list_booking_occurrences
tools.description: List booking occurrences (one calendar entry per booked date) in a date-time window of at most 31 days. Recurring bookings give one occurrence per date. Returns one page with paging.cursor. Skedda API: GET /api/v1/booking-occurrences.

tools.name: skedda_get_booking_occurrence
tools.description: Get one booking occurrence by its booking id and venue-local start date (the bookingId and the date part of start from a list item). Skedda API: GET /api/v1/booking/{bookingId}/occurrence/{date}.
